drhp.business: The Company manufactures in two segments, Plastic and Textile. drhp.expansion: The annual report discloses no capex programme, no capacity addition and no expansion project. litigation.note: An application by Bank of India as financial creditor under Section 7 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 for initiation of a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process against the Company is under process before the National Company Law Tribunal, Jaipur Bench. The Company's writ petition before the Rajasthan High Court, Jaipur Bench, challenging rejection of its One-Time Settlement proposal with the lending bank was dismissed and the Company is evaluating further legal remedies. BSE and NSE imposed fines for non-submission of the Standalone Statement of Impact of Audit under Regulation 33 of SEBI LODR and the Company's waiver application response is awaited. A case instituted against certain Directors under the Companies Act, 1956 resulted in conviction, which the Appellate Court set aside, acquitting the Directors of all charges.

risks.note: Bank of India, as financial creditor, has applied for initiation of a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process against the Company for non-payment of financial debt; the matter is under process before the National Company Law Tribunal, Jaipur Bench, and is the single legal case the Board flags as pending.
risks.risk: Insolvency proceedings under Section 7 of the IBC

risks.note: The Company's bank account has not been operative because it is unable to pay the bank's dues due to its adverse financial position; the Promoters want to settle the NPA loans but the Bank is not agreeable to the terms proposed, so day-to-day operations cannot run normally.
risks.risk: Inoperative bank account and unsettled NPA borrowings

risks.note: The Company has not received any order in the pipe line division and production has not been carried on for a long time, which the Board itself names as the reason the business has been adversely affected.
risks.risk: Production stoppage — no orders in the pipe line division

risks.note: The mink blanket product did not perform well over the last two to three years because of the heavy burden of financial cost over fixed assets, and the textile unit was closed — recorded by the Board as a change in the nature of business.

Due to paucity of funds the Company is not in a position to resume the business of the Yarn Division; a restart decision rests with the Promoters and depends on conditions turning in the Company's favour.

The Rajasthan High Court, Jaipur Bench, held that no case was made out to grant the OTS and dismissed the Company's writ petition challenging the lender's rejection; the Company is only evaluating further legal remedies, leaving the debt resolution path unresolved.
risks.risk: Failed One-Time Settlement and residual legal exposure

risks.note: BSE and NSE imposed fines for non-submission of the Standalone Statement of Impact of Audit under Regulation 33 of SEBI LODR; the Company's waiver application was made and the exchanges' response is still awaited.

Management states both the pipe and textile divisions need regular technological up-gradation as well as expansion to meet growing demand and reduce cost of production, while competition in the industry has increased considerably and overseas suppliers may affect growth prospects.
risks.risk: Need for continuous technological up-gradation amid rising competition

sk.overview: The Sheet Molding Compound (SMC) market comprises composite materials made from a combination of resin, filler, and chopped fibers, commonly used in automotive, construction, and electrical applications. SMC offers advantages such as lightweight properties, high strength, corrosion resistance, and design flexibility, making it a preferred alternative to metals in many industrial sectors, with growing adoption in electric vehicle components, renewable energy infrastructure, and industrial equipment.
